_comment: What the agent has to collect from the user before it can solve anything (T-01). required_for names the intent sections of knowledge_base.md and becomes the guard on leaving the data_collection state (T-02). pattern is the regex that spots the datum in a user turn; it is absent for free text, which no rule can detect, and the hybrid event detection of T-08 reads it from here so the same rule is never written twice.
